Log-Euclidean FC.notes: upper(logm(C)) of the shrunk correlation matrices, no harmonization

Riemannian re-centering.notes: Zanini et al. 2018: whiten each site by its Riemannian mean

Euclidean alignment.notes: He & Wu 2020: whiten each site by its arithmetic mean

Riemannian Procrustes.notes: Rodrigues et al. 2019, steps 1-2: re-centre and stretch to the hub

RLET.notes: Simeon et al. 2022: rigid log-Euclidean translation to the mean of site means

CORAL.notes: Sun et al. 2016, Algorithm 1 per site against the hub

MMD affine.notes: our own baseline: per-site affine map fitted by MMD to the hub
